title: Infinite Labyrinth
lyrics: In the hazy sky, shadows of memory,/n Who am I? Who are you?/n Behind the door, they’re calling me,/n With closed eyes, can you see me?/n /n Have you forgotten where the path leads?/n This road seems to repeat,/n Hey, who are you again?/n I can’t remember, I can’t remember,/n I can’t remember, fragments of thought./n /n Echoes in my ears, voices I can’t forget,/n Under the whispering moonlight,/n I want to escape, but there’s no way out,/n The dreams keep repeating, it’s all the same./n /n This eternal, spinning path,/n Unaware of where it goes,/n Looking into the mirror, I see myself,/n That’s not you anymore./n /n Who shouted? Who laughed?/n Countless faces leave traces,/n A clock that can’t stop for a moment,/n I can’t say goodbye anymore./n /n Through the glass, I see you smiling,/n Is that me, or is it you?/n Shadows swallow each other whole,/n In the moment, we merge and disappear./n /n This eternal, spinning path,/n Unaware of where it goes,/n Looking into the mirror, I see myself,/n That’s not you anymore./n /n In the lightless night, the unsetting dawn,/n Everything is fading away,/n When did I say goodbye?/n I can’t even remember that./n
